item.title: Rupert Lowe’s Restore Britain tests how far populist right will go
item.description: Have you ever thought that the problem with Reform leader Nigel Farage is that he is not nearly right-wing enough on immigration and race? If so, Rupert Lowe has a new party for you. The former chairman of Southampton FC fell out with Farage months after being elected as Reform MP in Great Yarmouth. item.description: AN ASIAN woman from the West Midlands has returned home from hospital after recovering from sepsis and now plans to raise awareness about the dangers of the condition.Manjit Sangha, 56, had all her limbs amputated after contracting sepsis in July last year.
